_comment: Cap rig. Sensor positions and angles are in config/sensor_layout.py (CAP table): edit them there. This file keeps the rig settings and each sensor's advanced settings: roll_deg (rotation about its own axis, 180 = upside-down), zone flips, and range calibration.
_zone_flip_note: 2026-11-15 hand test on the cap (S1): left/right came out mirrored, up/down correct -> zone_flip_h true. A pure mirror comes from the chip's zone numbering, so it applies to every board. zone_flip_v true from the desk test, confirmed by the hand test.
